body:
Fixes #1

## Summary

This PR delivers v0.0.1 of `lino-i18n` — a universal internationalization
library whose translations live in [Links Notation](https://github.com/linksplatform/Notation)
(`.lino`) instead of JSON or YAML. The repository ships two runtimes (JavaScript and
Rust) that consume **the same** `.lino` catalogues, plus a CLI that converts
existing `i18next`, `i18n-js`, and `react-intl` bundles into `.lino`.

## What's inside

### JavaScript (`js/`)
- `createI18n` runtime with CLDR plural categories via `Intl.PluralRules`.
- `.lino` catalogue loader built on `lino-objects-codec`.
- `{{var}}` and `{var}` interpolation (covers i18next and react-intl idioms).
- Context (gender) suffixes, namespace prefixes, configurable fallback chain,
  optional missing-key handler.
- Multi-runtime: Node.js (≥20), Bun, Deno, plus the standard bundlers.
- Converter CLI (`npx lino-i18n convert`) for `i18next` JSON,
  `i18n-js`/ruby-i18n YAML, and `react-intl` message bundles (AST or string)
  built on top of `lino-arguments`.

### Rust (`rust/`)
- `lino-i18n` crate with the same feature set as the JS package: CLDR
  plurals, dual placeholder syntax, context suffixes, namespaces, fallback
  chain, missing-key handler.
- `lino-i18n-macros` proc-macro crate exposing `i18n!`, which reads every
  `*.lino` file under a directory at **compile time** and bakes the
  translation tables into the binary. Generated `include_str!` constants
  make Cargo rebuild when catalogues change.
- `cargo run --example basic` demonstrates the runtime + macro flow.

### Case study (`docs/case-studies/issue-1/`)
- Long-form rationale for using `.lino` over JSON/YAML.
- Feature-by-feature comparison with `i18next`, `i18n-js`, `react-intl`.
- Code samples for each library and benchmark notes.

### CI (`.github/workflows/`)
- `js.yml` — Node + Bun + Deno test matrix on Ubuntu/macOS/Windows for any
  change under `js/**`, plus a CLI smoke test that round-trips an `i18next`
  catalogue.
- `rust.yml` — `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -- -D warnings`, and
  `cargo test --all-targets` on Ubuntu/macOS/Windows for any change under
  `rust/**`.

## Dependencies used (as requested in the issue)

| Purpose                       | Crate / package         |
| ----------------------------- | ----------------------- |
| `.lino` parsing (Rust + JS)   | `lino-objects-codec`    |
| CLI argument parsing (JS)     | `lino-arguments`        |
| Links Notation reference      | `links-notation`        |

## Test plan

- [x] `cd js && npm test` — 18/18 pass
- [x] `cd rust && cargo test --all-targets` — 21 + 5 + 0 + 0 pass
- [x] `cd rust && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` — clean
- [x] `cd rust && cargo fmt --all -- --check` — clean
- [x] `cd js && node examples/basic-usage.mjs` — prints expected i18n output
- [x] `cd js && node bin/lino-i18n.js --help` — CLI help renders
- [x] `cd rust && cargo run --example basic --quiet` — prints expected i18n output
- [ ] `.github/workflows/js.yml` and `.github/workflows/rust.yml` pass on push
title: Make 0.0.1 version of universal i18n library that uses Links Notation
